title: How to use your Free Coffee Sample funnel
titleHtml: How to use your Free Coffee Sample funnel
sub: Watch the training, then work the sequence below. This funnel does not deliver anything on its own, you mail the sample, so the follow up is the funnel.
stepsLabel: The follow up sequence, in order

video.title: How this funnel works
video.caption: Watch this before you start reaching out. About three and a half minutes.

steps.title: Confirm the mailing address
steps.lead: Send this the same day the request comes in. Nothing ships until you have the address in writing.

channels.label: Voice note and text
channels.note: Send the voice note and one text together. Rotate through the three texts so every lead does not get the same words.

parts.copyLabel: Copy the address confirmation voice note

Hey [Name]! It's [Your Name] 😊 Just locking in the details on your free coffee sample so I can get it shipped, can you send over your mailing address?
Your free sample of the world's best coffee is ready to go!

[Name], confirming your address for your free sample
Good morning [Name]!

steps.title: Confirm it is shipping, then send tracking
steps.lead: Send the first one as soon as they give you the address. Send the second only once it has actually gone in the mail.

steps.title: Tell them how to prepare it
steps.lead: Send this once they have received it, or a day or two after you expect it to land.

steps.title: Ask for the testimony at 48 hours
steps.lead: Send this if you have not heard back within 48 hours of step 3.

steps.title: Ask for the call
steps.lead: Send this once they have told you something good about the coffee. This is the close, and it only works after the testimony.

steps.title: Reopen a silent lead
steps.lead: Send this 5 to 7 days after no response to step 1 or step 4. This is your last, low pressure touch.

tip: Tip: Steps 1 and 2 lean on voice notes to keep it personal. Steps 3 and 4 can go by text since they are quick and informational. Step 5 is your close, so use a voice note or a call request, whichever feels more natural for the lead. Step 6 keeps the door open without being pushy, and it often revives leads who simply got busy. Personalize [Name], [Your Name], [X], [Tracking Number], [date] and [Order Link] before you send anything.
